decisions.reason: As a core two-component resin injection unit, it still fits the firm's established application-equipment portfolio, though overlap with another similar unit keeps some rationalization risk.
This injection unit also matches the firm's core business, but with two closely related resin systems in the range it has the highest chance of being dropped if management streamlines the portfolio.
An automatic airless spray gun is directly aligned with the firm's coating expertise and industrial customer base, so discontinuation within a year remains unlikely.
A manual airless spray gun is a standard complementary product with stable service and spare-parts logic, which argues for continued market presence.
The air-assisted airless spray gun line appears to be a committed multi-model offering in a core technology area, making near-term withdrawal the least likely among these products.
